decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory closely tied to the firm's trailer business, it is worth keeping unless several years of sales have clearly shown too little demand.
A box car trailer series is a core offer that fits the firm's production, dealer, and service strengths, so by 2022 it is more likely to be retained than abandoned.
A car transporter trailer is a more specialized and resource-intensive option, and after several years the firm would likely exit if demand has not proven strong enough.
A low-bed trailer series broadens the professional hauling range in a way that matches the firm's capabilities, making continuation the more likely choice.
A high trailer cover series complements the installed trailer base and can usually be kept on the market at relatively low incremental cost.
This box car trailer series remains close to the firm's main business, although some overlap with other trailer lines creates a moderate pruning risk.
